title: Inspect and extend: Test invariants and explain privacy limits
objective: Use the real implementation in `test/model.test.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve unit coverage, test command, pii sensitivity, and runtime evidence.
problem: Pure model tests make business rules repeatable, but they do not establish secure storage or accounting correctness. Build a demo and identify where real financial and privacy review would be needed. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `test/model.test.ts` and the related project files: test/model.test.ts; package.json; README.md.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to unit coverage, test command, pii sensitivity, and runtime evidence.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Do not store real employee expense data in this educational app.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Pure model tests make business rules repeatable, but they do not establish secure storage or accounting correctness. Build a demo and identify where real financial and privacy review would be needed.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `test/model.test.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Search for `expense needs a title and a positive amount` first.
Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
